spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Swift, speedy.
n. (-रं)
1 The spoke or radius of a wheel.
adv.
Swiftly.
m. (-रः)
1 A Jaina division of time, the sixth of an Avasarpiṇī or Utsarpiṇī. See अवसर्पिणी, &c.
2 The eighteenth Jaina Tīrthakara, or deified saint.
E.
ऋ to go, अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 The planet

MARS.
2

The planet SATURN.
n. (-रं)
1 An angle, a corner.
2 End, extremity.
3

Brass.
4

Oxide of iron.
f. (-रा)
1 A shoe-maker's awl or knife.
2 A probe.
E.
ऋ to go, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) See शैवाल.
E.
अर what goes, and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not preserved, not kept.
3 Unprotected, undefended.
E.
अ neg. रक्षित kept.

m. (घः)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.) See आरग्वघ.

m. (-ट्टः)
1 A machine for raising water from a well.
2 A deep well.
E.
अर quickly, and घट्ट to move, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
1 A wheel for drawing water with.
2 A deep or large well.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
Factitious or made up poison.
E.
अरम् quick, and गर poison.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
1 Free from the quality of passion.
2 Free from desire, &c.
f. (-जाः)
A young girl.
E.
अ neg. रजस् the menstrual flux, or passion, &c.

m. (-टुः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) See अरलु.
E.
ऋ to go, and अटच् aff.

mfn. (-णिः-णी)
Wood used for kindling a fire, exciting it by attrition.
m. (-णिः)
1 The plant of which especially the wood is used for this purpose, (Premna spinosa, &c). See गणिकारिका.
2 A flint.
3 The sun.
E.
ऋ to go, and अनि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-णिः)
An eddy.

nf. (-ण्यः-णी)
A forest.
m. (-ण्यः)
Kayaphal, a drug so named. See कट्फल.
E.
ऋ to go, and अन्य Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्यी-ण्यं)
Forest, wild, forest-born, &c.
E.
अरण्य a wood, अण् affix of derivation.

f. (-ली)
The wood or wild plantain.
E.
अरण्य, and कदली the plantain.

f. (-सी)
The wild cotton.
E.
अरण्य, and कार्प्पासी cotton.

m. (-कं)
A wood sparrow.
E.
अरण्य, and चटक a sparrow.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced or born in a forest.
E.
अरण्य, and ज born; also similar compounds, as अरण्यजात, अरण्योत्पन्न, अरण्यभव, अरण्यसम्भव, &c.

f. (-का)
Wild ginger.
E.
अरण्यज, and आर्द्रका ginger.

n. (-न्यं)
Wild rice.
E.
अरण्य, and धान्य grain.

f. (-का)
The gad fly.
E.
अरण्य, and मक्षिका a fly.

m. (-कः)
Keeper of a forest, superintendent of a forest district.
E.
अरण्य, and रक्षक who protects.

m. (-सः)
A raven.
E.
अरण्य, and वायस a crow.

m. (-सः)
A hermitage.
E.
अरण्य a wood, and वास abode.

m. (-सी)
A hermit, an anchorite.
E.
अरण्य, and वासिन who resides.

m. (-लिः)
Wild rice.
E.
अरेण्य, and शालि rice.

m. (-रः)
The wild hog.
E.
अरण्य, and शूकर a hog.

m. (-श्वा)
A wolf.
E.
अरण्य, and श्वन् a dog, the forest dog.

m. (-क्षः)
Keeper or ranger of the forests, a headman or superintendent of a forest district, an officer in the old Hindu government.
E.
अरण्य, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.

f. (-नी)
A large forest.
E.
अरण्य, आनुक and ङीष aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dull, languid, apathetic.
2 Disgusted, discontented.
E.
अ neg. रत interested.

m. (-पः)
A dog.
E.
अ neg. रत copulation, and त्रप ashamed.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Dull, languid.
2 Discontented, unhappy.
m. (-तिः)
Anger, passion.
f. (-तिः)
1 Dissatisfaction, discontent.
2 Dulness, languor.
3 Absence of pleasure, pain.
4 Anxiety, distress.
E.
अ neg. and रति pleasure, or ऋ to go, and अति Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तिः)
An enemy.
E.
अ neg. and रा to give, with ति affix; who does not give pleasure.

f. (-तिः)
1 Stopping, ceasing.
2 Waving lights before an image.
E.
आङ्, रम to play, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-तिः)
An enemy.
E.
आङ् before रा to take or receive, आति aff.

m. (-त्निः)
1 A cubit of the middle length, from the elbow to the tip of the little finger.
2 The elbow.
E.
ऋ to go, and कत्नि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Low, inferior. See अवम.

m. (-मः)
A garden, a grove.
E.
आङ्, रम to please, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Disagreeable.
E.
अ neg. रम्य pleasing.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 A door.
2 A covering, a sheathe.
3 The sheathe of the shoot of a bamboo.
E.
अर, from ऋ to go, and अरण Uṇādi affix, ङीष् in the fem.

mn. (-रिः-रि)
A door.
E.
ऋ to go, and अरिन् aff.

m. (-रुः)
An enemy.
E.
ऋ to go, अरु Uṇādi aff.

ind.
A vocative particle, expressing haste.

m. (-लुः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) See शोनाक.
E.
ऋ to go, अरु affix, and र is changed to ल, also अरटु.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Silent.
E.
अ neg. रव sound.

m. (-वः)
Sound.
E.
आङ्, रु to sound, अप् aff.

m. (-वः)
Sound.
E.
आङ्, रु to sound, affix घञ्; also आरव.

n. (-न्दं)
1 A lotus, (Nymphaea nelumbo.)
2 Copper.
E.
अर quickly, and विन्द to obtain, श affix; with reference to the lotus, as of quick growth.

m. (-भिः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
अरविन्द, and नाभि the navel, from which sprung the lotus that bore BRAHMĀ at the creation.

f. (-नी)
An assemblage of lotus flowers.
E.
अरविन्द, इनि and ङीप् affs.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Insipid, tasteless.
2 Dull, flat, (as a composition.)
E.
अ neg. रस flavour.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Unfeeling, dull, devoid of taste.
2 Flavourless, insipid, liter. or fig.
E.
अ neg. रसिक flavoured.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having, possessed of.
E.
अ neg. रहित left.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Cool, unimpassioned.
E.
अ neg. राग passion.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Cool, unimpassioned.
E.
अ neg. रागिन् impassioned.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Anarchical, having no king or governor.
E.
अ neg. राजन् a king, कन् aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
Defeat or destruction of a foe.
E.
अराति, and भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Crooked.
m. (-लः)
1

Resin.
2

An elephant in rut.
3 A bent or crooked, arm.
f. (-ला)
1 A modest woman.
2 A disloyal or unchaste one.
E.
अर what goes, आ before ला to take or give, and क aff.

mn. (-टः-टं)
Brass.
E.
आर what goes, and कूट a heap; composed of various materials.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Preserved, defended.
2 Proper or worthy to be preserved, &c.
m. (-क्षः)
1 Protection, guard, preservation.
2 The junction of the frontal sinuses of an elephant.
E.
आङ्, रक्ष to preserve, &c. घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what guards or protects.
m. (-कः)
1 A watchman, a patrole.
2 A village or police magistrate.
E.
आङ् before रक्ष to preserve, वुन् aff.

m. (-धः)
A plant, (Cassia fistula.)
E.
आङ्, रुज् sickness, बध what destroys.

m. (-ट्टः)
The name of a country, north-west of India.

m. (-जः)
A horse from the Āraṭṭa country.
E.
आरट्ट and ज born.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Forest, wild, forest-born or produced.
m. (-कः)
A forester, an inhabitant of the woods.
E.
आरण्य and कन् added.

m. (-शुः)
A wild or forest animal, as a buffalo, a monkey, &c.
E.
आरण्य forest, and पशु an animal.

m. (-शिः)
The sign LEO.
E.
आरण्य a forest beast, and राशि a sign.

n. (-लं)
Sour gruel made from the fermentation of boiled rice.
E.
आर what goes, from ऋ to go, and नाल smell.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.
E.
as before, कन् added.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Begun, commenced.
E.
आङ् before रभि to commence, affix क्त.

mfn. (-टः-टी)
Boldness, confidence.
f. (-टी)
A branch of the dramatic art, the machinery of the drama, the representation of magical incantations, &c.
E.
आर quickly, भट to nourish, अच् and ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Beginning, beginning resolutely with a determination to finish.
E.
आङ् before राभि to commence, शानच् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A beginning, a thing begun.
2 Haste, speed.
3 Effort, exertion.
4

Pride.
5

Killing, slaughter.
6 An introduction, a prologue, &c.
E.
आङ, रभि to commence, घञ् aff.

ind.
Having begun, beginning from.
E.
आङ् before रभि to commence, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
Insipidity, want of flavour or spirit.
E.
अरस and यञ् aff.

n. (-ग्रं)
The edge of a semicircular arrow head.
E.
आर what goes, and अग्र edge, &c.

ind.
1

Near.
2

Distant, far from.
E.
आङ् before रा to get, आत् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Near, proximate.
2 Remote.
E.
आरात् and छ aff.

n. (-कं)
Waving lamps at night before an image.
E.
आङ् before रात्रि night, कन added.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what worships, a worshipper.
E.
आङ् before राध and वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Accomplishment.
2 Acquirement, attainment.
3 Gratifying, propitiating.
4

Worshipping.
5

Cooking.
f. (-ना)
Service.
(-नी)
Worship, adoration, propitiation of the deities.
E.
आङ्, राध to finish, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be worshipped or adored.
E.
आङ् before राध to finish, अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य and य, आराधितव्य and आराध्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Worshipped, honoured, reverenced.
2 Propitiated, pleased.
3 Accomplished, effected.
E.
आङ् before राध to finish, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being worshipped, receiving worship, &c.
2 Being in course of fulfilment.
E.
आङ् before राध and शानच् aff.

mf. (-कः-की)
A cook.
E.
अराल crooked, ठक् affix; always bending over the dishes, &c.
